summary: Retest of the 8-criterion acceptance matrix (offers, PayU, GST invoices, customer accounts, Resend, Google auth, admin workspaces, public catalogue). All backend lanes pass in isolation; all browser checks pass after fixing 3 stale pre-existing artifacts (demo-customer credential removed from the app, post-login route changed from a direct /admin/orders or /admin/products deep link to the tabbed /admin overview, and the admin 'print view' label changed from 'ORDER INVOICE' to 'ORDER SUMMARY -- NOT A GST INVOICE'). Added a new backend test (simulated signed PayU webhook, no real charge) and a new browser check (HSN edit on a disposable fixture, never on an approved product) to close real coverage gaps. DB residue from re-running the full pre-existing suite was cleaned back to the exact genuine baseline (4 products, 8 categories, 3 collections, 5 order-requests, 2 users, 0 orders/invoices) before handback.
action_items: Google sign-in end-to-end login cannot be completed: the managed auth.emergentagent.com service's /oauth/ redirect returns HTTP 404 (platform-side, confirmed by support per briefing, not app code). App-side wiring (redirect origin, server-side exchange route) was verified by code inspection only. Needs the platform team to resolve; no action for this app's codebase.

3 pre-existing browser checks (admin-orders-access-denied-and-workspace, admin-catalog-full-edit-workflow / admin-catalog-add-edit-delete-product, customer-session-cannot-access-admin-ui, account-profile-wishlist-cart-persistence, admin-order-invoice-print-view) were stale from an earlier app iteration: they referenced a demo customer login (customer@safyra.co) that the app has since intentionally removed, assumed a direct deep-link route that now redirects through the tabbed /admin overview, and expected an old invoice-popup label. All were corrected in place this iteration; no app behavior was changed.

Running the full backend pytest suite in one shot (30 files) still leaves tscheck-prefixed residue in products/order_requests/users/orders/invoices because several pre-existing tests create rows through helpers that go through guest-checkout/order-request flows with no corresponding delete endpoint. This is expected per the fixture-discipline note (residue in the test's own tscheck namespace is acceptable) but requires a manual Mongo cleanup pass after any full-suite run; isolated per-file runs are clean. Recommend the main agent add an admin bulk-delete-by-prefix utility, or accept the documented manual cleanup step.

The pre-existing test_tscheck_invoice_generation_statewise.py and test_tscheck_gst_invoice_safety.py helpers hardcode country='United States' while varying state_region, so they never actually exercise the India CGST/SGST/IGST split; a new test (test_tscheck_gst_invoice_per_item_rules.py) using a simulated signed PayU webhook now covers the real India flow end-to-end and passed. The older files were left as-is (test-authoring issue, not an app bug) but their GST-specific assertions should be treated as superseded.
